history.p: "Seasonal pictures" has a very complicated genesis. (See preface in GW IV:11). The two first movements received their first performance at Musikforeningen on 10 February 1871, and during the following months Gade composed two new movements. All four movements were performed at Musikforeningen on 15 and 17 April 1872. The work was published in 1876, but at that time Gade had revised it slightly. It exists in two different instrumentations: with and without string quartet. The printed editions are all without the string quartet, but Gade himself preferred the full version.
